resolved_findings.resolution: Patched React RSC, Vite, Cloudflare, Wrangler, and related build dependencies; removed unused database tooling and replaced the vulnerable lint dependency tree with Biome.
Bound the host port to 127.0.0.1 and moved owner/application passwords into configurable environment values.
SQLite connections are explicitly closed after commit or rollback.
Dependency audits, an 80% coverage floor, security lint, and fresh PostgreSQL workload/baseline smoke checks are enforced.
The vulnerable setuptools 79.0.1 bundled in the GitHub Actions image is upgraded and pinned to setuptools 83.0.0 or newer before dependency auditing.
PostgreSQL parameter placeholders and blank representative SQL are blocked before analysis, and the user must explicitly confirm local synthetic EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution.
Imports enforce a bounded strict schema, read-only SQL validation, a matching SHA-256 query fingerprint, known measurement groups, and never execute imported SQL.

The pilot requires explicit authorization, an exact database-name match, a non-privileged read-only role, allowlisted representative SELECT queries, timeouts, and a second opt-in before EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
Chromium now exercises workload selection, explicit SQL approval, analysis, baseline storage, export visibility, and comparison in GitHub Actions.
